73133-araminta.title: Araminta
73133-araminta.creator: J. C. Snaith
73133-araminta.description: A book by J. C. Snaith. It was a quarter to nine in the morning by the ormolu clock on the chimney-piece; and the old lady, somewhat shriveled, very wide-awake, and in the absence of her toupee from the position it was accustomed to grace--at present it was in the center of the dressing-table--looking remarkably like a macaw, was sitting up in bed.

arxiv-1806-03702.title: A unification of the coding theory and OAQEC perspectives on hybrid codes
arxiv-1806-03702.creator: Shayan Majidy
arxiv-1806-03702.description: Abstract There is an advantage in simultaneously transmitting both classical and quantum information over a quantum channel compared to sending independent transmissions. The successful implementation of simultaneous transmissions of quantum and classical information will require the development of hybrid quantum-classical error-correcting codes, known as hybrid codes.

arxiv-2103-06977.title: Acoustic properties of metallic glasses at low temperatures – tunneling systems and their dephasing Dedicated to Siegfried Hunklinger on the occasion of his 80 th {}^{\text{th}} birthday
arxiv-2103-06977.creator: Arnold Meißner, Tim Voigtländer, Saskia M. Meißner, Uta Kühn, Susanne Schneider, Alexander Shnirman, Georg Weiss
arxiv-2103-06977.description: Abstract The low temperature acoustic properties of bulk metallic glasses measured over a broad range of frequencies rigorously test the predictions of the standard tunneling model. The strength of these experiments and their analyses is mainly based on the interaction of the tunneling states with conduction electrons or quasiparticles in the superconducting state.

arxiv-2108-03249.title: Nearly-frustration-free ground state preparation
arxiv-2108-03249.creator: Matthew Thibodeau, Bryan K. Clark
arxiv-2108-03249.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Matthew Thibodeau, Bryan K. Clark. Solving for quantum ground states is important for understanding the properties of quantum many-body systems, and quantum computers are potentially well-suited for solving for quantum ground states. Recent work [ 1 ] has presented a nearly optimal scheme that prepares ground states on a quantum computer for completely generic Hamiltonians, whose query complexity scales as δ − 1 \delta^{-1} , i.e. inversely with their normalized gap.

arxiv-2204-05349.title: Compression of a confined semiflexible polymer under direct and oscillating fields
arxiv-2204-05349.creator: Keerthi Radhakrishnan, Sunil P Singh
arxiv-2204-05349.description: Abstract The folding transition of biopolymers from the coil to compact structures has attracted wide research interest in the past and is well studied in polymer physics. Recent seminal works on DNA in confined devices have shown that these long biopolymers tend to collapse under an external field, contrary to the previously reported stretching.

arxiv-2204-08126.title: Optimal Power Flow in Four-Wire Distribution Networks: Formulation and Benchmarking
arxiv-2204-08126.creator: Sander Claeys Geert Deconinck, Frederik Geth
arxiv-2204-08126.description: Abstract In recent years, several applications have been proposed in the context of distribution networks. Many of these can be formulated as an optimal power flow problem, a mathematical optimization program which includes a model of the steady-state physics of the electricity network.

arxiv-2205-01894.title: Results on bar-core partitions, core shifted Young diagrams, and doubled distinct cores
arxiv-2205-01894.creator: Hyunsoo Cho, JiSun Huh, Hayan Nam, Jaebum Sohn
arxiv-2205-01894.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hyunsoo Cho, JiSun Huh, Hayan Nam, Jaebum Sohn. Simultaneous bar-cores, core shifted Young diagrams (or CSYDs), and doubled distinct cores have been studied since Morris and Yaseen introduced the concept of bar-cores. In this paper, our goal is to give a formula for the number of these core partitions on ( s , t ) (s,t) -cores and ( s , s + d , s + 2 ​ d ) (s,s+d,s+2d) -cores for the remaining cases that are not covered yet.

arxiv-2305-00856.title: Analyzing Transatlantic Network Traffic over Scientific Data Caches Conference: Proceedings of the 2023 Systems and Network Telemetry and Analytics; June 20, 2023; Orlando, FL, USA Proceedings of the 2023 Systems and Network Telemetry and Analytics (SNTA ’23), June 20, 2023, Orlando, FL, USA DOI: 10
arxiv-2305-00856.creator: Ziyue Deng, Alex Sim, Kesheng Wu, Chin Guok, Damian Hazen, Inder Monga, Fabio Andrijauskas, Frank Würthwein, Derek Weitzel
arxiv-2305-00856.description: Abstract . Large scientific collaborations often share huge volumes of data around the world. Consequently a significant amount of network bandwidth is needed for data replication and data access. Users in the same region may possibly share resources as well as data, especially when they are working on related topics with similar datasets.

arxiv-2310-06539.title: Surface chemical composition of single WNh stars Preprint: Fabrice Martins
arxiv-2310-06539.creator: Fabrice Martins
arxiv-2310-06539.description: Abstract Context. Wolf-Rayet (WR) stars of the WNh category contain a significant fraction of hydrogen at their surface. They can be hydrogen-burning, very massive stars or stars in a post-main sequence phase of evolution. Also, WNh stars are sometimes not included in population synthesis models. Aims.

arxiv-2503-22687.title: Qieemo: Speech Is All You Need in the Emotion Recognition in Conversations Thanks: * These authors contributed equally to this work.
arxiv-2503-22687.creator: 1 st Jinming Chen*, 2 nd Jingyi Fang*, 3 rd Yuanzhong Zheng, 4 th Yaoxuan Wang, 5 th Haojun Fei
arxiv-2503-22687.description: Abstract Emotion recognition plays a pivotal role in intelligent human-machine interaction systems. Multimodal approaches benefit from the fusion of diverse modalities, thereby improving the recognition accuracy. However, the lack of high-quality multimodal data and the challenge of achieving optimal alignment between different modalities significantly limit the potential for improvement in multimodal approaches.

arxiv-2505-18370.title: Clark-Ocone formula for the maximum of processes with the stochastic intensity and its application
arxiv-2505-18370.creator: Mahdieh Tahmasebi
arxiv-2505-18370.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mahdieh Tahmasebi. Pricing of the lookback options using the Clark-Ocone formula for the underlying assets driven by stochastic Lévy processes needs to compute the Malliavin derivatives of their maximum or minimum on the Wiener-Poisson space, as well as their distributions. In this work, we will find a generalization of explicit representation of the Clark-Ocone formula on the maximum of two types of Lévy processes with stochastic intensity; Cox processes with CIR-modeled intensities, and the Hawkes processes. Mathematics Subject Classification: 60H07, 60G51.

pmc-10737376.title: PERCEPTIONS OF HOME HEALTH AIDES (HHA) CARING FOR PERSONS LIVING WITH DEMENTIA (PLWD) ABOUT ADOPTION OF TELEHEALTH
pmc-10737376.creator: Zainab Toteh Osakwe, Michelle Odlum, Amarilis Céspedes, Sasha Perez
pmc-10737376.description: Home healthcare agencies serve a large and growing population of Persons living with Dementia (PLWD). The COVID-19 pandemic led to rapid adoption and use of telehealth services in the delivery of home healthcare, allowing patients to visit with home healthcare clinicians remotely using virtual technology.

pmc-11331649.title: Buyang Huanwu decoction ameliorates myocardial injury and attenuates platelet activation by regulating the PI3 kinase/Rap1/integrin α(IIb)β(3) pathway
pmc-11331649.creator: Jiaming Gao, Hao Guo, Junmei Li, Min Zhan, Yue You, Gaojie Xin, Zixin Liu, Xiaodi Fan, Qinghe Gao, Jianxun Liu, Yehao Zhang, Jianhua Fu
pmc-11331649.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundBuyang Huanwu Decoction (BYHWD) is a traditional Chinese medicine to treat the syndrome of qi deficiency and blood stasis. Platelets play an important role in regulating thrombus and inflammation after ischemic injury, studies have shown that BYHWD regulate myocardial fibrosis and exert anti-inflammatory effects through IL-17 and TLR4 pathways, but the mechanism of platelet activation by BYHWD in stable coronary heart disease is still unknown.

pmc-12617645.title: Global, regional and national estimates of the burden of childhood asthma attributable to NO2 exposure for 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023: a Global Burden of Disease study 2023
pmc-12617645.creator: Katrin Burkart, Sarah Wozniak, Susan Anenberg, Ana Pereda, Nora Gilbertson, Charlie Ashbaugh, Daniel Goldberg, Perry Hystad, Gaige H. Kerr, Susan A. McLaughlin, Arash Mohegh, Michael Brauer
pmc-12617645.description: SummaryBackgroundAsthma, a chronic lung condition characterised by inflammation and airway constriction, has been associated with nitrogen dioxide (NO2) exposure, an association that particularly impacts children. Our study rigorously assessed this relationship and estimated the global burden of childhood asthma attributable to NO2 exposure in 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2023.

pmc-12965278.title: Chemical modulation of the unfolded protein response reveals an antiviral role for the PERK pathway in human coronavirus 229E infection
pmc-12965278.creator: Isabella E. Pellizzari-Delano, Trinity H. Tooley, Debanjana Mondal, Keya Jani, Carla E. Gallardo-Flores, Che C. Colpitts
pmc-12965278.description: Broad spectrum antivirals are critical to respond rapidly to the threat posed by newly emerging RNA viruses. One potential candidate is the natural compound thapsigargin (Tg). Tg potently induces endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and activates the unfolded protein response (UPR).

pmc-13039888.title: Integration of immunogenic cell death in the treatment landscape of non-small cell lung cancer: harnessing the power of the immune system
pmc-13039888.creator: Zhe Liu, Xin Xu, Meijing Wang, Jianlei Zhang, Xuesong Zhao, Meina Wang, Fang Liu, Zhonghua Liu
pmc-13039888.description: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) accounts for 85% of lung cancer cases and is one of the leading causes of cancer-related death worldwide. Although traditional therapies such as chemotherapy, radiotherapy and molecular targeted therapy, as well as immunotherapy, have made substantial progress, drug resistance and tumour recurrence remain significant challenges.

pmc-13436193.title: Incidence of gestational diabetes and inequalities in adverse pregnancy outcomes in England: contemporary, cross sectional observational study of 2.7 million births
pmc-13436193.creator: Carlos Sánchez-Soriano, Niamh-Maire McLennan, Sara L White, Nithya Sukumar, Ponnusamy Saravanan, Robert S Lindsay, Thomas Bolton, Fionna Chalmers, Laura A Magee, Rebecca M Reynolds, Genevieve Cezard
pmc-13436193.description: ObjectivesTo quantify the incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus in England, determine inequalities in diagnoses and pregnancy outcomes, and assess the indirect effects of the covid-19 pandemic.DesignContemporary, cross sectional observational study.SettingPrimary and secondary care data from NHS England, based on the Hospital Episode Statistics Admitted Patient Care dataset, 1 January 2018 to 31 December 2022.

pmc-13560759.title: Generation of Herbicide‐Resistant Alfalfa Germplasm via Prime Editing
pmc-13560759.creator: Shihao Li, Xiuzhi Xia, Zhengzheng Wei, Na Wang, Hao Lin, Lifang Niu
pmc-13560759.description: Alfalfa (Medicago sativa) is the most widely cultivated forage crop worldwide, owing to its high protein content, balanced amino acid profile, and abundance of vitamins and minerals. However, weed infestation severely threatens alfalfa yield and quality. The lack of herbicide‑resistant cultivars, combined with the diversity of weed species, has made herbicide tolerance a key breeding objective.

uslaw-usc-t10-s240a.title: 10 U.S.C. § 240a — Audit of Department of Defense financial statements
uslaw-usc-t10-s240a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s240a.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization And General Military Powers); Chapter 9A (Audit). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Defense shall ensure that a full audit is performed on the financial statements of the Department of Defense for each fiscal year as required by section 3521(e) of title 31.

uslaw-usc-t18-s2315.title: 18 U.S.C. § 2315 — Sale or receipt of stolen goods, securities, moneys, or fraudulent State tax stamps
uslaw-usc-t18-s2315.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s2315.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 113 (Stolen Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever receives, possesses, conceals, stores, barters, sells, or disposes of any goods, wares, or merchandise, securities, or money of the value of $5,000 or more, or pledges or accepts as security for a loan any goods, wares, or merchandise, or securities.
